Label: Minor
ProcessSafety: Small, quickly isolated release; no ignition potential realised.
AssetOperations: Less than one shift lost; minor repair.

Label: Moderate
People: Medical treatment, restricted work or lost-time injury.
ProcessSafety: Release needing isolation and area evacuation.

Label: Major
ProcessSafety: Significant release with credible ignition; fire or flash-fire potential.
EnvironmentCommunity: Alert or evacuation beyond the fence line.

Label: Catastrophic
ProcessSafety: Jet fire, explosion or rupture of high-pressure equipment.
AssetOperations: Loss of a facility or trailer; prolonged shutdown.
EnvironmentCommunity: Public harm or major community impact.
